steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Disconnect circuit breaker or power cable before servicing electrical parts. Reconnect panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Make sure to disconnect the circuit breaker or power cable before servicing.

steps.title: Inspect sub PBA connectors
steps.body: Reconnect CN103 display control module and CON100 touch module. Check for condensation.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reconnect CN103 display control module and CON100 touch module. Check for condensation.

steps.title: No condensation on PBA?
steps.body: CN103 and CON100 must be dry. Remove moisture if present.
steps.sourceExcerpt: CN103 and CON100 must be dry. Remove moisture if present.

steps.title: Stuck button or object on panel?
steps.body: bC2/bE-2 when button held ≥30 s. Remove object; verify touch panel not damaged.
steps.sourceExcerpt: bC2/bE-2 when button held ≥30 s. Remove object; verify touch panel not damaged.

steps.title: Version display test (n1)
steps.body: In AS: Hi-Temp cycles n1. Normal=Sub PBA version, Heavy=Touch IC SW, Delicate=Model option, Express=Inverter SW, Rinse=WiFi module.
steps.sourceExcerpt: In AS: Hi-Temp cycles n1. Normal=Sub PBA version, Heavy=Touch IC SW, Delicate=Model option, Express=Inverter SW, Rinse=WiFi module.

steps.title: Replace control panel assy
steps.body: Replace display control module, touch module, or sub-wire when bC2/bC3 or condensation fault.
steps.oemOutcome: Replace display control module, touch module, or sub-wire when bC2/bC3 or condensation fault.

steps.title: HMI OK
steps.body: Touch panel and sub PBA verified.
steps.oemOutcome: Touch panel and sub PBA verified.
